steps.content: You don't know how you survived the ordeal.
When the final impact passes, the unspeakable being finally dissolves.
But you find no relief. Its voice still echoes in your ears.

steps.speaker: Discordant Whisper
steps.content: Your name was carved in the deep long ago...
You cover your ears and scream. A ringing fills your ears, and then, everything falls silent. You look up in disbelief. In the distant fog, a ship is floating peacefully.
Its outline is blurred and tattered, yet its shadow seems strangely real, almost familiar. You want to tell Shin, but only then do you realize: you're no longer on the radar platform.
Like the ship, you're floating above a dark land. The ocean breeze brushes past vaguely, carrying the faint scent of brine.
You've been through this before. In an illusion like this, there's only one choice to make.
